Binta Traore  
123 Innovation Drive, Sunnyvale, CA 94086 | (408) 555-0198 | binta.traore@email.com  

As a Senior Embedded Systems Engineer at InnovateTech Solutions, I’ve led the development of mission-critical systems for enterprise clients, blending deep technical expertise with a relentless focus on scalability and reliability. My career has spanned roles from designing low-level firmware to architecting real-time systems that interface with global IoT networks. Each project has reinforced my ability to translate complex requirements into robust, deployable solutions that align with business objectives.  

At InnovateTech Solutions, I spearheaded the migration of legacy sensor networks to a cloud-agnostic edge computing framework, reducing latency by 35% and enabling real-time analytics for industrial automation clients. This work required integrating heterogeneous sensors with Embedded Linux platforms, optimizing RTOS scheduling for deterministic behavior, and deploying MQTT-based communication layers to ensure seamless data flow. My contributions directly influenced the company’s ability to secure a major contract with a Fortune 500 client.  

Prior to that, as a Firmware Developer at SmartGrid Dynamics, I designed a modular firmware architecture for smart metering systems, supporting over 100,000 devices across North America. The solution leveraged CoAP protocols for secure, lightweight communication and incorporated edge computing capabilities to preprocess data before cloud transmission. This reduced bandwidth costs by 22% and improved fault tolerance during network outages. My work also involved mentoring junior engineers on best practices for C/C++ memory management and real-time task prioritization.  

Earlier, at CoreLogic Inc, I led the development of an embedded Linux-based platform for industrial control systems, integrating multiple sensor types into a unified data pipeline. This required crafting custom drivers for proprietary hardware and implementing RTOS-based threading models to handle concurrent I/O operations without compromising system stability. The project’s success was measured by a 40% reduction in downtime and a 25% improvement in response times for critical safety protocols.  

My career has been defined by systems that operate at the intersection of hardware and software, where reliability and performance are non-negotiable. I’ve consistently delivered solutions that scale from small startups to enterprise environments, ensuring that every line of code meets the demands of real-world deployment.  

University of California, Berkeley  
Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering | 2018  

**Projects / Side Projects**  
- **Edge-Enabled Industrial Monitoring System** (InnovateTech Solutions): Designed a distributed edge computing framework to process telemetry data from remote sensors, reducing cloud dependency and enabling localized decision-making. The system used MQTT for device communication and embedded Linux for real-time data aggregation.  
- **Smart Grid Firmware Optimization** (SmartGrid Dynamics): Refactored legacy firmware to support dynamic sensor integration, improving scalability and reducing power consumption by 18% through optimized RTOS task scheduling.  
- **IoT Protocol Interoperability Tool** (Personal Project): Developed a cross-platform tool to convert between MQTT and CoAP protocols, facilitating seamless communication between legacy and modern IoT devices. The project demonstrated proficiency in protocol stack design and low-level network stack customization.  

**Technical Skills / Technologies**  
- **C/C++ (embedded)**: Architectural decisions for real-time systems, mentoring teams on memory management and concurrency models.  
- **RTOS**: Designed scheduling algorithms for deterministic behavior, achieving sub-millisecond response times in safety-critical applications.  
- **IoT protocols (MQTT/CoAP)**: Engineered scalable communication layers for global deployments, reducing latency by 30% in edge-to-cloud architectures.  
- **Embedded Linux**: Built custom kernel modules for hardware integration, enabling seamless interaction with peripherals in resource-constrained environments.  
- **Edge computing**: Implemented frameworks for decentralized data processing, improving operational efficiency in distributed systems.  
- **Sensor integration**: Developed drivers for multi-sensor arrays, ensuring reliable data acquisition in challenging environmental conditions.
